article.title: Kenya facts of the day
article.excerpt: The total fertility rate for 2019 was 3.4 births which marks a drop of about one birth from 4.8 births in 2009. But here is the more interesting part: The gap between the highest and lowest TFR continues to increase – which is lowest at 2.5 children in Nairobi and 8 children per woman in Mandera County.
